description: This file is a jQuery plugin implementation of unobtrusive user notifications called jGrowl, version 1.4.5. It defines the plugin's functions, default settings, and internal methods for creating, rendering, updating, and managing notification messages.

methods.name: jGrowl
methods.description: Main function to create a notification on the default container or a specified container.

methods.name: jGrowl.prototype.create
methods.description: Creates a new notification message with specified content and options.

methods.name: jGrowl.prototype.render
methods.description: Renders a notification message in the DOM with animations and event bindings.

methods.name: jGrowl.prototype.update
methods.description: Updates the notification container, removing expired notifications and rendering new ones.

methods.name: jGrowl.prototype.startup
methods.description: Initializes the notification container and sets up periodic updates.

methods.name: jGrowl.prototype.shutdown
methods.description: Removes the notification container and stops updates.

methods.name: jGrowl.prototype.close
methods.description: Triggers the closing of all notifications in the container.
